1. Overview & System Rationale

Mathematical visual explanations (Venn diagrams, set theory operations, shape intersection proofs, geometry boolean demonstrations) require evaluating exact 2D Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) operations on arbitrary vector entities.
Retiam provides the [`BooleanOps`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/geometry/BooleanOps.ts) engine, which implements:

items: **Arbitrary Vector Entity Operands**: Accepts circles, rectangles, text glyphs, stars, gears, or complex SVG paths.
**World-Space Matrix Baking**: Automatically computes accumulated parent-to-world transformation matrices so entities at different positions, scales, or orientations can interact seamlessly.
**Robust Multi-Polygon Clipping**: Implements the Martinez-Rueda-Feito polygon clipping algorithm via `polygon-clipping`.
**Smooth Curve Reconstruction**: Simplifies collinear floating-point artifacts and reconstructs smooth $C^1$ cubic Bézier curves from discrete polygonal outputs.

3. Geometric Processing Pipeline
A. World-Space Matrix Baking

Because entities may reside inside nested groups ([`Group`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Group.ts), [`VGroup`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/layout/VGroup.ts)) or have localized position/rotation/scale offsets, `BooleanOps` computes the cumulative world transformation matrix:
Every vertex of the operand paths is transformed into common world space before clipping:
B. Martinez-Rueda-Feito Clipping
The engine models shapes as `MultiPolygon` structures:

The plane sweep algorithm handles complex self-intersecting boundaries, nested holes (e.g. donut geometries), and shared edge segments in $O((n + k) \log n)$ time, where $n$ is total edges and $k$ is edge intersections.
C. Collinear Simplification & Area Debris Culling

Floating-point arithmetic during clipping can introduce redundant collinear vertices along straight edges. Retiam evaluates the triangle area formed by three consecutive vertices $(p_{i-1}, p_i, p_{i+1})$:
If $\Delta < \text{simplifyTolerance}$, vertex $p_i$ is discarded. Rings with total signed area $|\oint y\,dx| < \text{minArea}$ are eliminated.
D. Curve Reconstruction
When `reconstructCurves: true`, adjacent linear segments with smooth tangent continuity are fitted with cubic Bézier control points:

The resulting curves are ingested directly into [`Path`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/primitives/2d/Path.ts) with hardware-accelerated anti-aliased SDF extrusion.
